It will include quiet periods, posture changes, rhythmic jaw movements, speaking, and drinking-related temperature dips. Both temperature sensors will share the same true temperature, with independent noise levels of 0.015 °C and 0.020 °C.

The dataset is generated and the checks passed: 180,000 rows with regular 10 ms timestamps. I also checked the plots and confirmed that the temperature channels share the same noise-free curve while their noise is independent. Event labels and noise-free data are saved separately for scoring.
